extraction.Name: Peter Larvie
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farming and working at odd jobs
extraction.NOTES: Allotment number 3433 appears in document along with number 3512 (possibly a file number). Peter Larvie states: 'I did not give a second mortgage to Petters and Co. for $231.46 like the records show as I only mortgaged it onece and then to Petters and Co.' Patent was sent by mail in 1920; did not sign the receipt. Has four children. In good health. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on 29th day of May 1929. Land sold for $800.00.
